main_diagnosis: Iter37 NLE=-602 is catastrophically worse than Iter36 (-415) and far from best-ever Iter16/18 (-52.5/-45.3). Simultaneous narrowing of BOTH β∈(0.15,0.50) and γ∈(0.05,0.15) has over-constrained the parameter space and likely excludes the true parameter values. The γ ceiling at 0.15 (1/γ≥6.7 days minimum) and β floor at 0.15 are the primary culprits — these boundaries prevent SBI from finding the correct posterior. The correct strategy is to moderately widen γ (restore plausible COVID range up to 0.20) and lower the β floor back to 0.10 while retaining the 0.50 cap. Only ONE range should be changed per iteration to isolate causal effects.

issues.description: γ range (0.05, 0.15) is too narrow and likely excludes the true recovery rate. Iter36 with γ∈(0.04,0.29) gave NLE=-415; Iter37 with γ∈(0.05,0.15) gave NLE=-602 — narrowing WORSENED performance, meaning the true γ is likely above 0.15. COVID-19 infectious periods of 5-10 days correspond to γ=0.10-0.20 [1/day], so the ceiling of 0.15 blocks SBI from finding faster-recovery scenarios. A moderate ceiling of 0.20 covers the full clinically-observed COVID-19 infectious period range without being as permissive as Iter36's 0.29.
issues.location: forward() — γ parameterization line: gamma = float(0.05 + 0.10 * sig_gamma)
issues.suggestion: Change γ parameterization to: gamma = float(0.04 + 0.16 * sig_gamma) giving γ∈(0.04, 0.20) [1/day], corresponding to infectious periods 1/γ∈(5, 25) days. At init raw_gamma=0.0: γ=0.04+0.16×0.5=0.12 [1/day], R0=β/γ=0.325/0.12≈2.7. This is one targeted change only — do NOT also change β in the same iteration.

issues.description: β floor raised to 0.15 excludes lower but epidemiologically valid transmission rates. Iter34 used β∈(0.05,0.70) and achieved NLE=-228; Iter36 used β∈(0.10,0.60) and achieved NLE=-415; Iter37 raised floor to β=0.15 giving NLE=-602. The monotonic degradation as the β floor rises strongly suggests the true β may be near or below 0.15. The β lower bound should return to 0.10 to allow SBI to explore the sub-0.15 region while retaining the 0.50 ceiling.
issues.location: forward() — β parameterization line: beta = float(0.15 + 0.35 * sig_beta)
issues.suggestion: After fixing γ first and measuring NLE, if still degraded: change β to beta = float(0.10 + 0.40 * sig_beta) giving β∈(0.10, 0.50) [1/day]. At init: β=0.10+0.40×0.5=0.30 [1/day]. This restores the lower bound to 0.10 (matching Iter36 which was better than Iter37) while keeping the 0.50 cap. Apply as a SEPARATE iteration from the γ fix to isolate causal effects.
